provenance.notes: Arc-level Douglas–Peucker 0.01° (topology-preserving). Provinces: Voronoi of cities + Halton/Lloyd seeds per landmass part (never across water). Sea zones: 0.05° raster, Poisson-like seeds, connectivity-checked. Reviewed straits/canals in scripts/map/crossings.ts. Territory manifest in src/data/territory-manifest.ts. See docs/MAP.md.
